title: Embeddings SDK: typed response contracts, iterator-style pagination, and backpressure control
creator: Maya Chen
description: Update Python and TypeScript Embeddings clients to expose strongly-typed response models, an iterator-style pagination API for large result sets, deterministic error classes for common server-side failures, and client-side backpressure/concurrency controls. This reduces developer friction when integrating reranking pipelines, improves retry semantics, and prevents client overloads that spike latency for downstream rerankers.
acceptance_criteria: Python and TS SDKs ship new EmbeddingResponse model with typed fields (id, vector, metadata) and versioned schema v2
Iterator-based pagination for embeddings that yields EmbeddingResponse objects and transparently handles server cursors
Typed exception classes for RetryableError, ValidationError, QuotaExceededError, and StreamingError with standard error codes
Client exposes configurable concurrency and buffer_size/backpressure options with sane defaults and docs
Integration tests covering pagination over 100k vectors, concurrent requests with varying batch sizes, and deterministic retry behavior
Migration guide (minor breaking change) and changelog entry in SDK-2.4.0
implementation_notes: Add EmbeddingResponse dataclass (python) and interface (ts) with explicit types for vector: List[float] / number[] and optional metadata: Dict[str,str] / Record<string,string>
Server cursor is opaque string token; client iterator accepts page_size and yields items lazily; page_size defaults to 512 and can be tuned per workload
Implement deterministic error mapping in client: map HTTP 429->QuotaExceededError (with retry-after), 5xx->RetryableError, 400->ValidationError including model name and offending param in message
Add backpressure: max_concurrency and max_inflight_bytes (approx by tokens*embedding_size) to avoid saturating network/runtime; TS client exposes same options
Add synchronous and async iterator variants for Python (__iter__/__aiter__) and async generator for TS (AsyncIterable)
Expose a typed PaginatedResponse<T> helper across SDKs to unify semantics for other paginated endpoints
Performance: prefer streaming JSON parser for large pages (ujson/ijson in python) and incremental decoding on TS side to limit memory spikes
Docs: code samples for reranking pipeline that consumes iterator and batches downstream similarity calls
Telemetry: emit metric client.pagination.pages and client.backpressure.drop_counts to Console for early rollout
